listing.name: VRAM Optimizer
listing.summary: A memory optimization mod that converts vanilla and modded textures into the DirectDraw Surface (DDS) format with BC7 compression.
listing.aiSummary: Converts vanilla and modded textures into DDS format with BC7 compression to reduce VRAM usage.

description:
VRAM Optimizer

Download by clicking the banner
Be sure to follow the README during installation
AMD GPUs might have crashes or issues, check the Troubleshooting guide if so

you can support me on (github is prefered)

What?
A memory optimization mod that converts vanilla and modded textures into the DirectDraw Surface (DDS) format with BC7 compression.

These native GPU-supported textures reduces VRAM usage by over 75% with practically zero quality loss.

You can see the different encoding options and how they look here:

Requirements & Compatibility

GPU Requirements (BC7 / DDS): A graphics card supporting BC7 (Block Compression 7) texture decompression. Practically any modern GPU from the last decade supports this natively in hardware.

Cons?
You will need to create the dds textures yourself which can take quite a while depending on your cpu speed (check README), will increase startup time a bit as well.

However
If using fast rendering 0.8.2 or above the startup time is faster instead of slower, as FR will use the dds textures directly
ALWAYS be sure to use the latest version of Fast Rendering if you are using it, as FR and this mod constantly updates according to each other

Big thanks to Genir for helping with the OpenGL and Wisp for helping with the encoding

If you have any questions ask here.
